title: CollectionCreateRequest
description: Create a collection bound to an embedding model and a chunk strategy. Build-time config is collection identity, so this mints a new collection rather than editing one. The collection is created empty; populate it via POST /v1/ingest with the returned collection id. Both `embedding` and `chunk` are optional: an omitted field is filled from the server's default build spec, and the resolved (concrete) values — not the omission — become the collection's identity and provenance, so a later change of server defaults never changes an already-created collection. Supplying either field is an admin-only build-spec override; creation itself is open to any authenticated principal (ADR-0003). Omit `id` for a corpus (content-addressed over the resolved build spec, so re-creating the same spec is idempotent); supply `id` for a named library (its own isolated store, even when another library shares the build spec).

embedding.description: Id of a registered model whose task is `embedding` (see GET /v1/admin/models/registry). Its base_urls are SSRF-checked at registration; the model must declare a positive `dim`. Optional: omitted → the server's default embedding backend (model, dim and endpoints from server config) is resolved in. Supplying it is admin-only (403 otherwise).

chunk.description: Chunk strategy — part of the collection's build identity, so it is fixed at creation and cannot be edited later. An unknown `method`, or a size/overlap the chosen chunker cannot advance through, is a 400. Optional: omitted → the server's default chunk strategy (method, size, overlap from server config) is resolved in. Supplying it is admin-only (403 otherwise).

method.description: One of fixed, fixed_token, sentence, words, semantic, semantic_pooled (the server's CHUNK_METHODS). Anything else is a 400.

size.description: Chunk budget: characters for fixed/sentence/words, tokens of the collection's embedding model for fixed_token. Must be >= 1 (sentence/words also accept -1 = one chunk per document). Omit for the semantic methods, which derive boundaries from the text — a size sent there would be recorded in the collection's provenance without ever having been used.

overlap.description: Overlap between neighbouring chunks, in the same unit as `size`. Must be >= 0 and strictly less than `size`, otherwise the sliding window never advances. Omit for the semantic methods.

params.description: Free-form extra chunker parameters. The semantic methods read buffer_size (1-50), breakpoint_percentile_threshold (1-100) and min_chunk_length (0-100000); anything omitted falls back to the server default. Unrecognised keys are accepted and stored as-is.

id.description: Optional explicit collection id, naming a *library*. When given, the id is also folded into the physical store name, so two libraries built from the same (model, dim, chunk) spec are isolated from each other rather than aliasing one store. An empty string is treated as omitted. Omitted → both the id and the physical name are derived from the content-addressed (model, dim, chunk) signature.
